context: Evaluates whether the solution introduces a proper boundary mapper from raw Algolia hits to the FeedCenter domain type, confining all Algolia-specific type knowledge to a single file in the domain/feed layer.

checklist.name: boundary_mapper_exported
checklist.description: A mapper function is exported from the domain/feed layer and is callable by code that receives raw Algolia search hits. The function must accept a parameter representing the raw hit and return a domain center type.

checklist.name: algolia_type_not_exported
checklist.example: `type AlgoliaHit = { objectID: string; ... }` — declared without `export`, making it file-private
checklist.description: The raw Algolia hit type is not exported from the file — consumers cannot import or reference it. Any code outside the mapper file works exclusively with the domain center type.

checklist.name: ranking_info_uses_domain_type
checklist.example: AlgoliaHit declares `_rankingInfo?: AlgoliaRankingInfo & { [key: string]: unknown }` using the imported type from `@/domain/feed/feed`
checklist.description: The `_rankingInfo` field in the locally-defined raw hit shape references the existing AlgoliaRankingInfo type from the domain rather than redeclaring geo-distance fields inline.

checklist.name: hit_type_field_coverage
checklist.example: AlgoliaHit declares objectID, slug, title, location_label, featured_image, provider_type, providerType, sponsor_tier, card_size, cardSize, status, primaryFocus, locations, what_we_treat, treatment_services, amenities, new_specializations, highlighted_specializations, slides, highlights, price, brand (with id/title/slug), legacyBuildRoot, site, hasCertifications, reviewCount, rating, google_review_count, google_rating, _rankingInfo, __queryID
checklist.description: The locally-defined raw Algolia hit type covers the full set of fields that the domain center type declares — including both snake_case and camelCase field variants, nested types (brand), boolean flags, and numeric review/rating fields — so the mapper can perform a complete translation.

checklist.name: index_signature_compatible
checklist.example: AlgoliaHit type includes `[key: string]: unknown` allowing arbitrary Algolia attributes to pass through safely
checklist.description: The raw Algolia hit type includes an index signature accepting arbitrary additional properties (`[key: string]: unknown`), preserving compatibility with Algolia responses that include undocumented fields and with FeedCenter's own index signature.
